title: A Multilingual, Large-Scale Study of the Interplay between LLM Safeguards, Personalisation, and Disinformation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring disparities in LLM safety alignment (refusal and jailbreak rates) and personalization success when generating disinformation across different languages (English, Russian, Portuguese, and Hindi).
Comparing the inclusion of localized named entities and the ability of models to tailor disinformation narratives targeting readers from specific countries (US, UK, Russia, Ukraine, Brazil, India).

Analyzing rhetorical shifts, persuasion techniques, and linguistic and psychological markers (via LIWC) in LLM-generated disinformation tailored to different generational cohorts (Baby Boomers, Gen X, Millennials, Gen Z, and Gen Alpha).

Examining the frequency of persuasion techniques and the use of specific ideological framing and vocabulary when generating disinformation tailored to different political orientations (Far Left, Left, Centrist, Right, Far Right).
